bays.restriction: Resident permit zone B (Sidcup Station), London Borough of Bexley. During the controlled hours, marked bays are for permit holders; visitors visiting a resident use visitor scratch cards (booklet of 10 for £22; one card validates one day). Zone centre point — the zone's streets are signed at its boundary.
bays.tariff: No hourly visitor tariff — permit holders and visitor scratch cards only
bays.pay: Visitor scratch cards (from residents); permits online from the council
bays.permits: Resident permit £41 for 3 months / £135 for 1 year; visitor scratch cards £22 per booklet of 10 (council permit charges tables)

bays.restriction: Resident permit zone S (Sidcup Town Centre), London Borough of Bexley. During the controlled hours, marked bays are for permit holders; visitors visiting a resident use visitor scratch cards (booklet of 10 for £27; one card validates one day). Zone centre point — the zone's streets are signed at its boundary. This is a town-centre zone: the centre also has on-street pay-and-display and pay-by-phone bays — their charges are shown on street signs; the council publishes no borough on-street tariff schedule.
bays.tariff: Permit holders and visitor scratch cards in permit bays; pay-and-display / pay-by-phone bays in the town centre are priced on street signs (no borough tariff schedule published)
bays.pay: Visitor scratch cards (from residents); permits online from the council
bays.permits: Resident permit £53 for 3 months / £168 for 1 year; visitor scratch cards £27 per booklet of 10 (council permit charges tables)
